name: Lucy
source:
Pro snowboarder and master of the slopes, Lucy always brings the heat.

But competition can be fierce in her elite winter world. She has to use every trick in the book to stay on top, even if that means using her beauty to get ahead.

Ruthless and driven to win, Lucy will do anything to be the best. And being the best creates opportunity.

As a rising social media star, Lucy must capitalize on her fame for fortune!

[From [url=https://www.dumbkoala.art/MeetTheCast/info.php?name=Lucy]DumbKoala[/url]]
